info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Tracks-v5-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipment Tracking API provides essential insights into the status and progress of shipments. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can access detailed tracking information for multiple logistics shipments at once, facilitating enhanced supply chain visibility. Typical consumers include logistics managers, supply chain analysts, and customer service representatives who require timely updates to coordinate operations efficiently. This API helps in monitoring shipment locations, estimated delivery times, and overall shipment health.

get.summary: Track the status of a shipment.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to track the current status of their shipments, providing real-time updates on location and estimated arrival times.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary parameters for tracking shipments. It must contain the appropriate details to identify the shipment you wish to track.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the tracking details.
